rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an activity that amuses, diverts, or stimulates.

example.english: Going to the movies on weekends is my favourite recreation.
example.traditional: 週末去睇戲係我最鍾意嘅娛樂。
example.jyutping: zau1 mut6 heoi3 tai2 hei3 hai6 ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 ge3 jyu4 lok6

rows.note: Use this when the recreation is specifically a leisure pastime or a way to relax.

example.english: After retiring, I garden every day for recreation.
example.traditional: 退休之後，我每日都用種花嚟消閒。
example.jyutping: teoi3 jau1 zi1 hau6 ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 jung6 zung3 faa1 lai4 siu1 haan4

rows.note: Use this for recreation with an emphasis on playing and having fun rather than organized entertainment.

example.english: The children are happiest going out with friends for recreation during the holidays.
example.traditional: 小朋友放假最開心就係同朋友出去玩樂。
example.jyutping: siu2 pang4 jau5 fong3 gaa3 zeoi3 hoi1 sam1 zau6 hai6 tung4 pang4 jau5 ceot1 heoi3 wun6 lok6
